license.result: MIT; exact pinned source license reviewed

license_and_network_boundary: No upstream install scripts, release/canary workflows, update command, remote target application, or publication step will run. Cargo network fetch used only checksum-verified crates.io inputs; source and all subsequent builds remain offline.

project_risks.detached_processes: The product starts a detached runner service and then task children. TestRunner helper assigns per-test HOME/XDG runtime/data roots and calls runner stop on drop; test harness Drop is best-effort, so campaign scenarios require independent process-tree proof/cleanup after each case.
project_risks.target_commands: Restrict configured child commands to pinned static scripts that write within the scenario workspace or wait under bounded time; do not start real services, access real project folders, use remote/Git credentials, or run installer/update commands.
project_risks.tui: Use a real PTY for attach/keyboard scenarios; terminal dimensions, escape sequences and exit/runner cleanup must be observed.

readme.product: Process manager for development and production; dependency/restart handling, CLI and TUI, embedded JavaScript

scope: Source and build-hook identity review only; no target execution, scenario qualification, platform compatibility, admission, or 30/100 credit.

upstream_build.network_resolution: Cargo fetch was performed under owned CARGO_HOME against exact lock checksums; subsequent build/test must use offline and locked mode.

root_build_script.review: Only traverses static docs source and writes an include_str module under Cargo OUT_DIR.

upstream_build.workspace: Cargo.toml default member src; members helpers/print-key and src

upstream_workflows.build.yml: Cross-platform release package creation with target matrices; not needed for CI verification.
upstream_workflows.canary.yml: Publishes a mutable canary release and runs update tests; excluded.
upstream_workflows.ci.yml: Build and test workspace on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows; rustfmt check on Ubuntu. Campaign selection tests Linux/Windows only.
upstream_workflows.release.yml: Creates GitHub releases and publishes crate/npm/PyPI artifacts; excluded.
